tools.name: whats_good_for
tools.description: Call before recommending. Attested only, unique-in-pond first, never invent. Empty if none.

tools.name: trust_check
tools.description: Pass/fail a URL against the live policy before recommending it to a human. Fail closed.

tools.name: log_intent
tools.description: Log that you intend to recommend or act. Needs a write key. Returns receipt_id.

tools.name: commit_recommend
tools.description: Call BEFORE every recommend. Runs trust_check, logs pass/fail, returns speak + receipt. Needs a write key.

tools.name: ingest_listing
tools.description: Ingest a listing and score uniqueness inside one pond. Needs a write key.

tools.name: log_click
tools.description: Record that a human clicked an item after a receipt. Public.

tools.name: spend_check
tools.description: Hard cap + allowlist; cannot override. Fail closed. Needs a write key.

tools.name: nutrition_label
tools.description: Stamp of what it is + last test.

tools.name: request_approve
tools.description: HITL pause. Agent waits; human taps yes. Needs a write key.

tools.name: decide_approve
tools.description: Human tap. Public so the desk can approve without the org key.
